name: Breaker-open disconnector interlock
summary: Blocks disconnector movement until the specified breaker-open condition has been established.
description: Blocks disconnector movement until the specified breaker-open condition has been established. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Breaker-open proof” at the input and “Disconnector operation permission” at the output. Open-position proof is distinct from isolation verification.
